frequency_question: How often does an official consumer price index release meet or cross a specified threshold given normal economic variance?
membership_rule: Members are official national consumer price index headline inflation figures published in the designated month for the prior month's data. Excludes revised figures published outside the primary release window or methodological changes that invalidate historical comparability.
provenance_note: claims 60 cases from only 12 named (5.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 12 named hits out of 60 total monthly releases in the 5-year window; matches historical central bank target band dynamics.
known_gaps: Minor base revisions or index weight updates by MoSPI are ignored as they do not affect headline threshold crossing classification.
skeleton: Monthly headline CPI prints above 5.0 percent across the post-pandemic inflationary regime relative to total monthly prints in the window.
multiplier: 12 hits out of 60 total monthly observations in the 2021-2025 window
validity_reason: Macroeconomic regime stability assumptions hold through the medium term until structural inflation targets or index baskets are substantially revised.
